name: HubSpot
tagline: HubSpot is a leading CRM platform that unifies marketing, sales, and customer service with AI running through every product. Its AI features include content generation, lead scoring, email subject line optimisation, chatbots, and a conversational intelligence layer across calls and deals. Over 205,000 companies use HubSpot as their core go-to-market system, from funded startups to enterprise brands.
